ruleDefinitions.name: Invoke-Obfuscation Via Use Rundll32 - System
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via use Rundll32 in Scripts Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, ImagePath

sequences.query: (Provider_Name = "Service\ Control\ Manager" AND event_id = 7045 AND (ImagePath = RGX(".*\\&\\&.*") AND ImagePath = RGX(".*rundll32.*") AND ImagePath = RGX(".*shell32\\\.dll.*") AND ImagePath = RGX(".*shellexec\\_rundll.*")) AND (ImagePath = RGX(".*value.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*invoke.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*comspec.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*iex.*")))
